scene.speaker: valentina
scene.bubble: Exam secrets from the Fjord Club: listen twice, colour carefully… and remember to breathe!
scene.intro: Exam secrets from the Fjord Club! Valentina's rules: listen twice, because you always hear the answer the second time. Read the example first — it tells you what to do. Colour carefully and only what they ask. Mateo adds his own rule: check everything at the end, because he always writes his name last. Ready for the exam? Take a pencil and breathe!
